These are fast 401s, not a dependency timeout.

verdict.recommendedAction: Verify MAILER_API_KEY version 6 in the secrets store against the email provider. Either revert template-svc to key version 5 (if still valid) or re-issue/fix the key at the provider, then restart or reload template-svc. Check why version 5 was revoked before the new key was active. Once the key is valid, the 502s at the gateway should clear.
